title: Possible a keystore password passed with --storepass in source
description: The file contains a keystore password passed with --storepass. Command lines are copied into scripts, CI jobs, container entrypoints and shell history, so one committed argument spreads far past the file that first held it. Shape-only: the match does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Rotate the credential, remove the literal argument from the script, and let the tool read the value from an environment variable, a protected credential file, or a secret manager.
limitation: Shape-only: a specific tool flag followed by a password- or token-shaped literal. It cannot prove the value is live, and it does not see credentials assembled at run time from several variables.
